verdict.rationale: Devin's docs recommend carving out independent tasks and running them simultaneously, and each cloud session gets its own VM that keeps working after you close your laptop. The API and MCP server expose session creation, management and scheduling for launching work programmatically. Community reports confirm sessions can run autonomously for days, with a configurable max work time to cap them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of fleet-scale or batch parallel session launching and concurrency limits, and independent hands-on corroboration of many agents running in parallel.
